newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Texmaco units finalise 1996 dividends.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Texmaco units finalise 1996 dividends.

text.p: Three companies in Indonesia's Texmaco group -- PT Texmaco Perkasa Engineering, Polysindo Eka Perkasa and Texmaco Jaya -- have received shareholder approval to pay final 1996 dividends, the group said.
It said in a statement that shareholders had approved a proposal by engineering firm PT Texmaco Perkasa Engineering to pay a final dividend of 90 rupiah.
It said polyester producer Polysindo Eka Perkasa and textile manufacturer PT Texmaco Jaya would pay final dividends of 60 rupiah and 30 rupiah per share respectively.

The newspaper also reported that Texmaco Jaya is increasing its weaving and and finishing production capacity to 160 million yards and 228 million yards respectively this year, from 97 million yards and 160 million yards in 1996.
